deviations: First-stage F-statistics are cluster-robust (historical county) Wald F on the single excluded instrument (equivalent to Kleibergen-Paap Wald F); iid first-stage F values are printed as diagnostics but not scored.
Latitude/longitude use the dataset's labelled 'latitude'/'longitude' variables (projected coordinates), not y1/x1 (degrees).
notes: Data: replication_data.dta (325 English districts). Sample: 298 districts with non-missing Domesday mills. Dependent variable wrights/pcmean, regressor mills/pcmean (pcmean = mean population 1710-50; common per-10,000 scaling does not change slopes). Wheat suitability = 1(wheat_tmean <= 5); river suitability = riv_rug26count (river length at ruggedness 2-6); instrument = river suitability x wheat suitability. Controls: geo = latitude, longitude, dist_rug_mean, dist_elevation_mean; agri = suitmean, wheat indicator, dist_grass_mean; climate = precip_mean_dist, temp_mean_dist; other = pcmean, min_harbor, DIST_London, min_dist_to_roman_rds, min_dist_2nav_rivers, area. Table 3 OLS col5 = Table 2 col5 + river suitability; IV cols 2/4/6 include river suitability and wheat suitability as controls plus the respective control sets. All estimated with fixest, SEs clustered by GAZ_CNTY (35 clusters). attempt-1 was an exploratory variable inspection with no RESULT lines; the final run is the first scored run.
